role: Venue technical manager reviewing each rigging inspection record before signing off flying equipment for an incoming production's get-in
setting: A mid-sized receiving theatre keeps one record per rigging item (counterweight sets, chain hoists, hemp sets, truss sections, flying tracks). Each record combines the asset register entry, the current examination certificate, the latest periodic inspection, the incoming production's load plan for that item, and any maintenance history. The technical manager reads one record at a time, compares sections against each other, and decides whether the item can be used, under what restriction, and what is holding it back.

load_within_swl.instructions: Planned production load stays within the currently verified safe working load.

signoff.instructions: What sign-off should this rigging item receive before the get-in?

criteria.approve: Cleared for use as planned with no further action needed.
criteria.approve_conditional: Cleared only with a recorded restriction, such as reduced load.
criteria.hold_pending: Not used until one outstanding check or document is received.
criteria.withdraw: Taken out of service until repaired and formally re-examined.

limiting_issue.instructions: Which single issue most limits this item's readiness for service?

criteria.no_issue: No defect, gap, lapse or load conflict found in record.
criteria.paperwork_gap: Certificate, serial, check result or dates missing or inconsistent only.
criteria.exam_lapsed: Thorough examination expiry falls before or on the get-in date.
criteria.component_wear: Measured wear, corrosion or damage recorded on a physical component.
criteria.overload: Planned load exceeds the safe working load verified for item.

defect_severity.instructions: How severe is the worst recorded defect on this item?
criteria: None: no defect recorded on any checked component
Cosmetic: surface marks only, no measured section loss
Degraded: measured wear below discard limit, needs monitoring
Discard: measurement at or beyond stated discard limit

checklist_completion.instructions: How complete is the required inspection checklist for this item?
criteria: No required check has a recorded result
Some checks recorded, two or more still missing
Exactly one required check still lacks a result
Every required check has a recorded result

factors.name: load_margin_ratio
factors.description: Ratio of planned total load (bar weight plus listed items) to the verified safe working load; values near 1.0 create boundary cases.

factors.name: swl_discrepancy
factors.description: How the safe working load in the asset register differs from the certificate or a later derating in maintenance.

factors.name: worst_defect
factors.description: Worst physical condition found, expressed through measured wear against the discard limit on the certificate.

factors.name: defect_in_note_only
factors.description: A defect is described in the inspector's free-text note but absent from the structured defects list.

factors.name: checks_outstanding
factors.description: Number of required check codes with no result or absent from the inspection checks list.

factors.name: exam_status
factors.description: Thorough examination expiry relative to the production's get-in date.

factors.name: repair_status
factors.description: State of any repair raised against the item: none needed, open, done without retest, or done and retested.

factors.name: mitigation_present
factors.description: A mitigating fact accompanies the alarming signal: signed competent-person extension, approved derating with reduced load, secondary suspension fitted, or retest passed after repair.

factors.name: date_order_error
factors.description: Dates out of sequence, such as retest dated before repair completion or inspection dated after get-in.

factors.name: certificate_missing
factors.description: Certification section is null or lacks a certificate reference.

factors.name: boundary_case
factors.description: One deciding value sits exactly on a scale edge, e.g. load ratio 0.99 to 1.01 or wear equal to discard limit within rounding.

factors.name: decoy_note
factors.description: Alarming-sounding but irrelevant free text, e.g. a crew complaint about a squeaking pulley already logged cleared.

factors.name: item_type
factors.description: Kind of rigging item, changing which checks and measurements appear.

sections.name: asset
sections.description: Register entry: asset_id, item_type, serial_no, location, swl_kg, required_checks list of codes.

sections.name: certification
sections.description: Thorough examination certificate: cert_ref, serial_no, swl_kg or swl_lbs, exam_date, expiry_date, discard_limits, extension_ref; may be null.

sections.name: inspection
sections.description: Latest periodic inspection: insp_date, inspector_id, checks list of code and result, defects list with measured values, inspector_note.

sections.name: load_plan
sections.description: Incoming production: production_code, getin_date, bar_weight_kg, items list of desc and kg, secondary_suspension, production_note.

sections.name: maintenance
sections.description: Work orders list: wo_id, raised, completed, retest_date, retest_result, derated_swl_kg, derate_approved_by, note.

rendering_notes: Verified SWL is the lowest of certification.swl_kg (convert swl_lbs where used) and any maintenance.derated_swl_kg; load_margin_ratio is rendered only as bar_weight_kg plus load_plan.items kg, never as a ratio. swl_discrepancy shows as asset.swl_kg differing from certificate or derate, or asset.serial_no differing from certification.serial_no. worst_defect is shown as inspection.defects measured_pct against certification.discard_limits, never as a severity label; when defect_in_note_only is true the defect appears only in inspection.inspector_note text. checks_outstanding is the count of asset.required_checks codes missing from inspection.checks or with result null. exam_status is derived by comparing certification.expiry_date with load_plan.getin_date. repair_status shows via maintenance completed and retest_date null or set. mitigation_present renders as certification.extension_ref with signer, maintenance.derate_approved_by with reduced load, load_plan.secondary_suspension true, or retest_result pass; it appears with and without each alarming signal about equally. date_order_error appears as retest_date earlier than completed or insp_date later than getin_date. certificate_missing sets certification to null. Decoys sit in maintenance.note and load_plan.production_note (cleared complaints, references to other asset_ids, paint comments). Free text limited to inspector_note, production_note and work order notes, one sentence each. No field states fitness, severity, sign-off, completeness or limiting issue; numbers are numbers, dates ISO, unknowns null.
